key_insight: InterGenEHR+ generates synthetic EHR records and longitudinal patient trajectories conditioned on clinician-specified scenarios.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support scenario-based evaluation of machine learning models in data-sparse critical care settings.
method: An optional LLM parser translates natural-language requests into structured constraints.
Conditional variational autoencoders and diffusion models generate single-time-point records.
Diffusion models generate longitudinal patient trajectories.
evidence_signal: Evaluation using a multi-institutional cohort of 874 VV-ECMO patients found retained mortality-prediction utility across five random seeds and three classifiers, with clinician ratings supporting trajectory plausibility and scenario alignment.
watch_item: Findings are limited to the evaluated VV-ECMO cohort; use in other clinical settings requires further validation.
paper_title: InterGenEHR$^+$: An Interactive Framework for Natural Language-Conditioned Generation of Longitudinal Patient Trajectories
